reviews.title: Classic bait and switch
reviews.text: Fluently claims one “can the AI tutor any time one wants.”  Nowhere does it state that you will be cut off from the app after 100 minutes per week. Classic bait and switch and a class action suit waiting to happen. Scammers.

reviews.title: It’s so bad for beginners
reviews.text:
Pretends to be appropriate for beginners and then throws you into the deep end with no way to tell it to ease up. The pricing is a total scam. I think the ratings must all be paid bots. Apple should investigate.

Update: Response noted. Why no free trial? Why did the price drop by 50% when I declined to pay? *Sketchy*

There are other apps that you can use for free or pay a fraction of the price with WAY better functionality. Hence my usage of the term “scam”.

And I tried adjusting the settings. Slowing down the speech is not the same as adjusting language level.

reviews.title: Scam.
reviews.text: The subscription limits were not clear when I signed up. After only three days of using the app, I’m already at 95 of the 100 speaking minutes allowed for the entire week, and now I’m being prompted to pay for another upgrade. Several advertised features are still marked “Coming Soon,” and the app also freezes frequently. I like the basic idea, but the pricing structure feels misleading and the app is not reliable enough to justify the cost.

reviews.title: Wish I had this app years ago

This is my holy grail giving me that safe space to practice and make mistakes without feeling embarrassed. If you’re in a similar situation I am in then I would take this as a sign to invest time into this app!

reviews.title: the reviews of this app are clearly fake
reviews.text:
you have a huge string of 5 star reviews, all saying something along the lines of 

“i am not a native english speaker but this app is revolutionary, its the most incredible app ive ever used. i’ve used the app for a week now and let me tell you, i’ve gained the confidence to speak with people at work. can’t wait to share it with the rest of my friends. 10/10. I am learning english now at a breakneck pace”

then you gotta ask yourself… so did this person use chat gpt to write the review?  cause how does a new to english user use words like revolutionary or breakneck pace with perfect grammar? especially when it looks like they just downloaded the app?

the ios store should audit the comments and then ban this app from the appstore for dishonest practices.
